dz: 日本本州北部仙台周边地区发生了 8.4–9.0 Mw 三陆地震。海啸造成的洪水向内陆延伸了几公里。
de: The 8.4–9.0 Mw Sanriku earthquake strikes the area around Sendai in northern Honshu, Japan. Inundation from the tsunami extended several kilometers inland.
